name: Vent gateway
ownerWords:
is Vent fully implemented and functioning rn? make it so it is. follow the original proposal discussion, all external API/webhook should pass here, we should be tracking OTEL ...

completely remove all legacy sdk, API keys from old deployments.

10-19: ACTUALLY remove all the direct API keys from all apps
goal: Every in-scope outside API call site and inbound webhook goes through Vent in prod, with GeoNode proxy egress the one allowed exception, and no deployment other than Vent holds a provider key, except the Slack token the alarm fallback keeps. On 10-19 the intent audit moved call success and host health to the duty Vent integrations, so this duty holds the cutover and the keys. Two problems kept coming back here: key copies left in old places (.bak files on us-metal01, the old Railway vent service, research-agent-be tier files, expired Instagram copies), which provider_keys_outside_vent counts, and direct provider calls showing up again at main outside the inventory (search's old PostHog client, 28 unlisted files on 10-19), which the new_direct_site rows show. Since 10-19 the call-site list comes from the code at the sieun/dev tip, so a site whose call the tip removed leaves the count and a new direct call there counts.

metrics.label: In-scope call sites and webhooks that go through Vent in prod
Provider keys still held by deployments other than Vent

onMiss: Read the flagged rows and steer the live job that owns each one, or start one fix job when none is live, with the metric's name in its brief. site_direct and tip_site_direct rows go to the p8 job 'vent cutover train' by app, and webhook_direct rows go to the p4 job 'vent webhooks'; a site counts only once its code is on main, which prod runs. A site_removed row needs no action: the tip removed that call, so it left the count, and prod drops it at the next promote. A no_prod_traffic row means the code at main calls Vent but prod Vent logged no successful vent.call for it in 7 days: check the caller's VENT_URL and VENT_KEY in prod. A new_direct_site row is a direct provider call at the tip that no inventory row covers, and it counts as a direct site until the p8 job moves it to Vent. vent-share.py takes Vent's integrations from apps/vent/src/vent/tables.py, so a provider with no integration there needs one in Vent. provider_keys_outside_vent above 0: each key_outside_vent row names a location and key names, and the p3 job 'vent cutover train' removes a key once no caller there reads it, .bak copies on us-metal01 included. Never print or copy a key value. A source_error row means a source was not read, so fix the read before trusting the number. No outside sends (c37). Merges, pushes and prod promotes need no go before the launch (c74). All on target: end the turn with no message.
